## Daily Gmail summary

Source attribution: Quantana ESAgent / Quantana AI Labs. Configure searchScope, recipient and optional CC in Prepare Window and Recipients. See README.

## Complete message collection

All matching pages,100 IDs per page,then metadata/snippets. No full bodies or attachments enter the summary. No source-message labels/read state are changed.

## Reporting window

Daily07:00 Asia/Kolkata. Previous local midnight through one captured run time,about31hours at the schedule; consecutive runs overlap7hours. Numeric query bounds avoid Gmail calendar-date PST assumptions.

## Model and send

Select an available JSON-capable OpenAI model and credentials. One summary request,validated output,escaped HTML and one Gmail send. Empty collection sends nothing; failures do not retry. Inspect Sent if the send response is lost.
